{
  "root_cause": "Traffic from VLAN 80 is blocked at two points: VLAN 80 is missing from the allowed VLAN list on the core-facing trunk link of the access switch, and the router's ACL for VLAN 80 only permits traffic to VLAN 20 instead of VLAN 10.",
  "confidence": 100,
  "evidence": "show interfaces trunk on the access switch shows Vlans allowed on trunk do not include VLAN 80 (only 1,10,20,30), and show access-lists VLAN80-ACL on the router shows traffic is only permitted to 10.10.20.0/24.",
  "next_command": "show running-config interface g0/1 (or the specific trunk interface on the access switch)",
  "fix_steps": [
    "Modify the trunk interface on the access switch to allow VLAN 80 (switchport trunk allowed vlan add 80).",
    "Update the router's VLAN80-ACL to permit traffic destined for VLAN 10 (10.10.10.0/24).",
    "Verify ping connectivity from a PC on VLAN 80 to the file server on VLAN 10."
  ]
}

parsed.root_cause: Traffic from VLAN 80 is blocked at two points: VLAN 80 is missing from the allowed VLAN list on the core-facing trunk link of the access switch, and the router's ACL for VLAN 80 only permits traffic to VLAN 20 instead of VLAN 10.
parsed.evidence: show interfaces trunk on the access switch shows Vlans allowed on trunk do not include VLAN 80 (only 1,10,20,30), and show access-lists VLAN80-ACL on the router shows traffic is only permitted to 10.10.20.0/24.
parsed.next_command: show running-config interface g0/1 (or the specific trunk interface on the access switch)
fix_steps: Modify the trunk interface on the access switch to allow VLAN 80 (switchport trunk allowed vlan add 80).
Update the router's VLAN80-ACL to permit traffic destined for VLAN 10 (10.10.10.0/24).
Verify ping connectivity from a PC on VLAN 80 to the file server on VLAN 10.
